title: Work query validation: bound combined Windows CLI arguments
outcome: Round-1 Claude Low, work_visualizer_types.rs:26: four independently accepted 16-KiB fields can exceed the Windows CreateProcess 32767-character command-line limit including configured paths and quoting; spawn then returns misleading upstream 502. Set realistic field/aggregate budgets (including UTF-16 and escaping where relevant) and reject oversized client input before spawning. Cursor stays opaque; base its cap on the supported CLI contract, not token internals.
acceptance: Boundary tests cover combined fields and Windows quoting/UTF-16 expansion; oversized queries return 400 without spawning, while valid supported cursors still work.
